summary: Latency-sensitive smoke test of PWA Salon booking app. Backend endpoints for services, salon, slots, bookings (incl. conflict), and auth login all pass. Frontend: landing loads with hero + services, admin protected route redirects when logged out, admin login (wrong/correct password) works with toast + redirect, admin dashboard shows stats + all 5 tabs, 3-step booking flow completes with WhatsApp confirmation link (wa.me), deep link /agendar?service={id} jumps to step 2, logout clears session and redirects to /admin/login. PWA manifest served correctly.
passed: GET /api/salon returns salon info (Studio Gel & Beauty)
GET /api/services/{id}/slots returns correct slot list with availability
POST /api/bookings creates booking with whatsapp_link (uses client_name/client_phone fields)
POST /api/bookings duplicate returns 409 Horário já reservado
POST /api/auth/login returns {token, user} with valid creds
Landing page loads: title, hero, services grid render
Protected /admin redirects to /admin/login when logged out
Admin login wrong password shows error toast
Admin login correct creds redirects to /admin, stats + all 5 tabs (agenda/servicos/bloqueios/clientes/lembretes) render
Booking 3-step flow: pick service -> date -> slot -> details -> confirm -> WhatsApp link visible with wa.me href
Deep link /agendar?service={id} jumps to step 2 (date & horario view)
Logout button clears session; /admin then redirects to /admin/login
notes: Login response key is 'token' (not 'access_token'); frontend correctly stores it as localStorage.access_token. Booking API expects client_name/client_phone (not name/phone). Server 'today' during test was 2026-09-24 with all today-slots unavailable (past business hours in server timezone) — expected behavior. WhatsApp integration is MOCKED (wa.me deep links only, no real message send).
